quote_policy.eligibility: Full30seconds must remain before the original timeframe decision_bar+120second deadline. Otherwise keep immediate market and record WAIT_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE. Source decision bars use original M30/H1 definition.
quote_policy.wait: Evaluate later ticks strictly after decision ordinal. First full-spread price-improving executable quote before or at decision+30seconds triggers; otherwise first valid quote at/after that bound, at most3seconds later and not after original deadline, is the market fallback. A later adverse move is not ignored. Missing terminal coverage/fallback remains explicitly unscored; no future completeness determines an earlier model forecast.
quote_policy.label: direction*(immediate executable price-wait executable price)/initial spread. Preserve raw label, clip[-10,10]only for fit/update. Availability is decision_ms+33000 for every scored sample, conservatively after the entire fixed quote window; update only strictly later decisions. Trigger time/ordinal, fallback,initial/exitspread and price-saving cash with source volume are separately recorded.
quote_policy.cost: Standalone quote saving=direction*(immediate price-wait price)*source original volume*unit contract. Stressed incremental saving adds0.5*(initialspread-waitspread)*sourcevolume, representing the change in the extra entry half-spread charge when the exit side is held equal for selection. This is not realized candidate profit; slippage, commission,stop geometry,financing,admission and actual doubled-cost equity are native-only.
